chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Safwan, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Mus'ab, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) in hardship and ease, in freedom and constraint, until Islam became numerous and strong.'

And Ali (peace be upon him) took from them (the people) that they should prevent Muhammad and his descendants from what they prevented themselves and their offspring from. So I took it from them. Rescued was the one who was rescued, and destroyed was the one who was destroyed.'

key_terms.أُمِرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What was the nature of Ali's pledge of allegiance to the Prophet regarding hardship and the protection of his family?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the comprehensive nature of Ali ibn Abi Talib’s pledge (bay'ah) to the Prophet, encompassing all states of ease and hardship until Islam's dominance was established. It underscores the covenantal obligation of the community to protect the Prophet and his progeny (Ahl al-Bayt) as they protected themselves, linking this protection to the ultimate spiritual outcome of salvation or destruction. This narrative reinforces the Shia concept of the enduring authority and protective status of the Imams within the Islamic community.

en.hubeali: H 14822 – Narrated to us Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali, from Safwaan, from Muhammad Bin Ziyad Bin Isa, from Al-Husayn Bin Mus’ab, who has said: Abu Abdullahasws has said: ‘

Amir-ul-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> had pledged allegiance to the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup>, to be (loyal) in the hardship, and ease, and the freedom, and the restriction, until such time Al-Islam spreads and becomes strong’.

And Ali<sup>asws</sup> took from them (Shites) (a Covenant) that they shall prevent from Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and his<sup>saww</sup> descendants, what they had prevented themselves as well as their own children from. So I<sup>asws</sup> also took from them (Shites). Rescued was the one who was rescued, and destroyed was the one who was destroyed’.
